# Fireworks updates serverless pricing for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash

 Confirmed 19 Sep 2026 

## What you need to know

Verified evidence trail

What changed

Fireworks updates serverless pricing for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash

Why this matters

Fireworks says serverless pricing for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash changed on Oct. 1, 2026. Standard and priority rates now have new uncached input, cached input, and output prices per 1M tokens. The change applies only to serverless usage; dedicated deployments and Reserved Throughput are unaffected.

+ October 1, 2026 at 00:00 UTC

+ , serverless pricing for

+ DeepSeek V4.1 Flash

+ changes (uncached input / cached input / output price per 1M tokens):

+ Standard:

+ $0.22 / $0.007 / $0.66 →

+ $0.30 / $0.006 / $1.20

+ Priority:
